decision: Approve the card-link-action-label, content-detail and decorative-cover-word conventions scoped to the whole-card action label, context detail and decorative cover-word responsibilities; the cover-badge convention and its TipCard and ArticleFeatureCover badge exceptions remain bound by the TipCard receipt, not re-approved here.

evidence.interpretation: Explicit approval of the four conventions offered in the owner questionnaire (card-link-action-label, content-detail, decorative-cover-word and cover-badge), recorded in L17. The cover-badge proposal was later re-scoped by the owner naming amendment (docs/components/web-catalog/v0.1/cover-badge-naming-amendment.md): canonical coverBadge with the badge alternative limited to TipCard and ArticleFeatureCover, bound by the TipCard receipt, so this receipt records only the remaining three conventions. Each meaning is verbatim approved proposal content from the ArticleFeature v0.1 spec (issue #280, contentSHA256 9b099d34e4fd042f93d16f704fdb2741ac222220d96c3fb335a2340f29a994b6); whenToUse and avoid are materialized at implementation following the TerminalCard receipt precedent, with the registered contentHash binding the exact registered text. Not native review authority.

convention.name: actionLabel
convention.meaning: Visible text of a whole-card link's action affordance, rendered as paint and text only because the card element is the single link.
convention.whenToUse: A whole-card link offers a visible action affordance that stays paint and text inside its single anchor.
convention.avoid: Nested links or buttons, a second interactive action, or any control semantics for the label.

convention.name: detail
convention.meaning: Short visible factual detail shown beside a content unit's context label, such as reading time or publication date; never an accessible description and never a control prop.
convention.whenToUse: A content unit's context row shows one short consumer-formatted fact beside its context label.
convention.avoid: Accessible descriptions, selectable-option metadata, controls, or component-computed reading times and dates.

convention.name: coverWord
convention.meaning: Oversized decorative word rendered as visual identity inside a media cover region and hidden from assistive technology.
convention.whenToUse: A generative or poster cover carries an oversized decorative word as the cover's visual identity.
convention.avoid: Meaningful text, accessible names, brand marks or interactive content.
